answer: Cross-tier threshold grading finalizes each answer only when M signatures arrive from distinct reputation tiers, never one clique. A sybil farm holding merely low-tier wallets cannot complete the panel, so it must build genuine standing across tiers per identity or recruit outside veteran graders who slash junk. The lagoon of cheap fake accounts stays shallow; a shale of cloned ballots lacks the onyx weight of a senior signer, and each missing tier is a gap no script fills.
